EmailTemplate.name: Registration Notification to Customer
EmailTemplate.subject: Registration Completed Successfully!
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Dear {!Account.Name} ,
Greetings from Modon Customer Management.
We are pleased to inform you that your property {!ServiceRequest__c.Unit_Name__c}. has been successfully Registered at Abu Dhabi Real Estate Center. Please find your Registration Certificate attached to this email for your reference. Should you require any further assistance or have any questions, please do not hesitate to contact us at customercare@modon.com or 800Modon.
Thank you for choosing Modon. We appreciate your trust in our services.
Best regards, Modon Customer Management
